name: notepadia-pair-programming-prompt
auditedRef: main @ f7f3d0e ("test: add 44 unit tests for extracted pure logic and wire into yarn test (M24 prep)")
auditMethod: Full source read of extensions/notepadia/src (browser, common, electron-main), applications/browser/package.json, applications/electron, e2e/, extensions/notepadia/test/, .github/workflows/, docs/ and README.md, compared line-by-line against the claims in notepadia_prompt_20260919.json and against the Notepad++ 8.x UI surface (menus, toolbar, tab bar, status bar, Find dialog, panels).
objective: Close the gap between 'Theia with Notepad++-shaped menus' (what exists today) and 'a browser application that a Notepad++ user recognizes as Notepad++ on sight and by muscle memory'. The browser target at http://localhost:3000 is the shipping product for this work; Electron is packaging only and is addressed last.
primaryConsumer: The repository owner runs the browser build exclusively. Electron/macOS/release debt is retained at low priority because the artifact is distributed to others.
rulesCarriedForward: Keep every @theia/* package on the 1.75.0 line. Never add a standalone monaco-editor dependency; use @theia/monaco-editor-core.
Keep product-specific behavior inside extensions/notepadia. Do not fork Monaco, reimplement the filesystem, or replace Theia's command/keybinding/menu architecture.
Improve the browser application first. Electron is touched only when packaging or when a feature is provably Electron-only.
Keep react/react-dom as direct dependencies of application packages.
Do not reintroduce Yarn Berry artifacts (.pnp.cjs, .pnp.loader.mjs, .yarn/unplugged).
Do not claim a build works unless it has actually been built and run.
Extract pure logic into extensions/notepadia/src/common/*.ts and unit test it with node --test in extensions/notepadia/test/*.test.cjs.
Every user-visible feature gets a Puppeteer e2e suite in e2e/ and is added to the SUITES array in e2e/run.cjs.
Commit each task on completion before starting the next one.

Update documentation with each task, in the same commit: README.md ('What is implemented'), docs/usage.md, docs/index.md and CHANGELOG.md. Never batch documentation updates as a separate step done 'at the end' - a task is not 'done' until its documentation describes what the code actually does.
Date-based product versions (YYYY.M.D) generated by scripts/set-build-version.mjs; repo stays 0.0.0; tags are vYYYY.M.D.
newRules: Any new UI must be usable with the keyboard alone and must expose an accessible name. The maintainer's domain is accessibility; a mouse-only toolbar or panel is a defect, not a nice-to-have.

Any new visual styling goes into a single stylesheet layer owned by the extension (src/browser/style/*.css) imported from notepadia-frontend-module.ts, and uses Theia color tokens registered by the Notepadia theme rather than hard-coded hex values scattered in TypeScript. The one existing hard-coded style injection (notepadia-search-mark.ts, document.head <style>) is migrated into that layer.
Browser-hostile keybindings (anything the browser reserves: Ctrl+N, Ctrl+W, Ctrl+T, Ctrl+Shift+N/T/W) must ship with a working non-reserved alternate and must be documented, not silently broken.

No feature is 'done' because a command exists. Done means: command + menu entry in the Notepad++ position + keybinding + visual affordance (toolbar/status bar/panel where Notepad++ has one) + e2e coverage.

verifiedCompleteInCode: Menubar structure: File, Edit, Search, View, Encoding, Language, Macros, Settings, Help - registered across notepadia-menu-contribution.ts, notepadia-encoding-contribution.ts, notepadia-eol-contribution.ts, notepadia-language-contribution.ts, notepadia-macro-contribution.ts, notepadia-updater-contribution.ts.
Theia/VS Code menu clutter is actively unregistered from File and Edit (notepadia-menu-contribution.ts unregister() calls).

M23 is genuinely implemented, contrary to the risk that it was only described: Macros (notepadia-macro-contribution.ts, record/stop/discard/run/clear + REC status bar item + top-level Macros menu), Column Editor dialog (notepadia-column-editor.ts, text/number/repeated with leading zeros, handles Alt+drag multi-selection), Blank Operations submenu and Split Lines / Remove Consecutive Duplicate Lines (notepadia-blank-and-line-operations.ts + src/common/blank-ops.ts), Search > Mark submenu with a 5-style decoration palette and Select and Find Next (notepadia-search-mark.ts), View > Document Map minimap toggle (notepadia-contribution.ts).
Line operations, case conversion, indent/unindent, toggle comment, sort/reverse/dedupe, go to line, matching bracket - all wired to Monaco actions in notepadia-contribution.ts.
Encoding conversion (UTF-8, UTF-8 BOM, UTF-16 LE/BE, ANSI) and EOL conversion (LF/CRLF/CR) with re-save.
Recent Files submenu, capped at 15, persisted through StorageService.
Document List panel widget + View menu entry.
Status bar: language, Ln/Col, encoding, EOL, indent mode, and a static INS element.
Tooling: ESLint 10 flat config passing, 44 unit tests over src/common, 16 Puppeteer e2e suites, 4 GitHub workflows (build, e2e, release, docs), MkDocs site.
promptClaimsRequiringCorrection: notepadia_prompt_20260919.json treats the product as feature-complete apart from macOS packaging and a short M24 list. That is accurate about COMMANDS and inaccurate about the product's appearance: the repository contains zero CSS files and zero theme/color contributions, so the browser app renders as stock Theia dark chrome with a Notepad++-shaped menubar. The single largest remaining body of work is visual, and it is not represented anywhere in v6.0.0.

The v6 'missingNotepadplusFeatures' list is missing the Notepad++ toolbar entirely. The toolbar is the most recognizable element of the Notepad++ window and is the first thing a user notices is absent.

The v6 list treats Search > Mark as satisfying the Search menu. Notepad++'s Ctrl+F is a persistent tabbed dialog (Find / Replace / Find in Files / Mark) with Search Mode radio buttons, direction, wrap-around, in-selection, Count and Find All. Notepadia currently exposes Monaco's inline find widget plus a separate Mark submenu, which is a different interaction model, not a styling difference.

notepadia-menu-contribution.ts unregisters 'workspace:open' and 'file.upload'/'file.download'. In the browser target that removes both the only menu route to open a folder AND the only route to move a file between the user's own computer and the server-side workspace. For a browser-deployed editor this is a functional regression, not menu tidying.
The status bar INS element is a hard-coded string. Notepad++'s Insert key toggles INS/OVR and the status bar reflects it. Notepadia has no overtype mode.
View > Document Map calls control.updateOptions() on the current editor control only. The setting does not persist and is lost when the user switches or reopens a tab.
M22 step 9 (a workflow_dispatch run of release.yml) and the first published vYYYY.M.D release remain genuinely unverified; they are retained here as G3/G4.
auditFindings.headline: Feature parity is roughly 70% and interface parity is roughly 20%. Someone opening http://localhost:3000 today sees a VS Code-shaped IDE whose menus read like Notepad++. The work below is ordered so the recognizability gap closes first.

workstreams.title: Visual identity and shell chrome
workstreams.rationale: This is the entire 'look' half of 'look and feel' and none of it exists. Nothing else in this document changes the first impression as much.

tasks.title: Notepadia Classic color theme and stylesheet layer
tasks.nppReference: Notepad++ default (Settings > Style Configurator, Default style)
tasks.problem: No .css file and no theme registration exist anywhere in the repo. The app inherits Theia's dark default; Notepad++'s identity is a light chrome with a white editor, a thin line-number gutter, and a specific selection/current-line palette.
steps: 1. Add a 'style' directory under src/browser and create index.css that @imports notepadia-shell.css and notepadia-marks.css. Import it from notepadia-frontend-module.ts with `import '../../src/browser/style/index.css';` following the Theia extension convention, and add a copy step to the extension build script (`"build": "tsc -p tsconfig.json && node scripts/copy-static.mjs"` or a cpx-free node copy) so the css lands beside lib/browser. Verify the browser build emits it; Theia's esbuild pipeline resolves css imports from extension lib directories.

2. Author notepadia-classic.color-theme.json as a VS Code-format light theme keyed to Notepad++ defaults: editor.background #FFFFFF, editor.foreground #000000, editorLineNumber.foreground #808080, editorLineNumber.activeForeground #000000, editor.selectionBackground #C0C0C0, editor.lineHighlightBackground #E8E8FF, editorCursor.foreground #000000, editorIndentGuide.background #C0C0C0, editorWhitespace.foreground #A0A0A0, plus token colors matching Notepad++'s default lexer palette (keywords #0000FF bold, strings #808080, comments #008000 italic, numbers #FF8000, operators #000080, preprocessor #804000).

3. Extend the same JSON with workbench colors so the chrome matches: titleBar/menubar #F0F0F0 with #000000 text, statusBar.background #F0F0F0, statusBar.foreground #000000, tab.activeBackground #FFFFFF, tab.inactiveBackground #E1E1E1, tab.border #ADADAD, sideBar.background #F0F0F0, panel.background #F0F0F0, focusBorder #0078D7.
4. Author notepadia-classic-dark.color-theme.json as the equivalent of Notepad++'s dark mode (editor.background #1E1E1E, chrome #2D2D30) so users who expect dark are not forced to stock Theia colors.

5. Create notepadia-theme-contribution.ts registering both themes via MonacoThemingService.register({ id, label, uiTheme: 'vs' | 'vs-dark', json }) from '@theia/monaco/lib/browser/monaco-theming-service', bound as a FrontendApplicationContribution (or registered in the module body, whichever Theia 1.75 requires - check node_modules/@theia/monaco/lib/browser/monaco-theming-service.d.ts before writing).

6. Make Notepadia Classic the default: set `"workbench.colorTheme": "Notepadia Classic"` inside theia.frontend.config.preferences in applications/browser/package.json (and mirror in applications/electron/package.json). Confirm a first-run profile with no stored preference lands on it.

7. Move the five .notepadia-mark-N rules out of the document.head <style> injection in notepadia-search-mark.ts into notepadia-marks.css, and delete the onStart() style-element code. Keep the STYLES array for class-name assignment only.

8. Set the editor font stack in the same preference block: `"editor.fontFamily": "Consolas, 'Courier New', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace"`, `"editor.fontSize": 13`, `"editor.lineHeight": 0`. Notepad++'s default is Courier New 10pt; Consolas-first with Courier New fallback reads correctly on Linux and Windows.
9. Build (`yarn build`), start (`yarn start`), and screenshot http://localhost:3000 beside a Notepad++ screenshot. Iterate on the palette until the editor surface is indistinguishable at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: A cold-profile browser load renders a light window with a white editor and grey gutter without the user touching preferences.
Both Notepadia Classic and Notepadia Classic Dark appear in Settings > Preferences theme picker and switch cleanly.
No TypeScript file contains a hard-coded color string; `grep -rn '#[0-9a-fA-F]\{6\}' extensions/notepadia/src --include=*.ts` returns nothing.
Search > Mark highlights still render in all five colors after the stylesheet move.
tests: New e2e suite e2e/theme.cjs: boot, read getComputedStyle on .monaco-editor .view-lines background and on the statusbar, assert the light palette; switch to the dark theme via the preference and assert it changes.
Add 'theme' to SUITES in e2e/run.cjs.

tasks.problem: Theia's left activity bar, side panel handles, breadcrumbs, editor gutter glyph clutter, and default status bar items announce 'this is VS Code'. Notepad++ shows a single optional docked panel on the left and nothing on the right.

In it, collapse the right panel (`shell.rightPanelHandler.container.hide()` or shell.collapsePanel('right')) and leave the left panel collapsed by default, matching Notepad++ where the Folder-as-Workspace panel starts hidden.

3. In notepadia-shell.css hide the vertical activity/side tab bars (.theia-app-sides .p-TabBar.theia-app-left, .theia-app-right) when a body class `notepadia-chrome` is present, and add that class in the contribution's onStart so the styling is opt-outable for debugging.

tasks.title: Notepad++ toolbar
tasks.nppReference: Notepad++ toolbar (the icon strip below the menubar)
tasks.problem: Completely absent. There is no top-area widget in the repository and no toolbar contribution. This is the single most recognizable missing element.
steps: 1. Decide the icon source before writing code. Preferred: draw a 16x16 SVG sprite in the Notepad++ visual idiom (flat, saturated, 1px outline) under src/browser/icons/toolbar.svg with <symbol id="npp-new"> etc. Fallback: Theia's bundled codicons via `<i class="codicon codicon-new-file" />`, which ships with @theia/core and needs no new asset pipeline. Pick one and be consistent; do not mix.

2. Create NotepadiaToolbarWidget extending ReactWidget from '@theia/core/lib/browser/widgets/react-widget'. Give it id 'notepadia.toolbar', `this.addClass('notepadia-toolbar')`, and a render() that maps a declarative TOOLBAR_ITEMS array to <button> elements.

3. Define TOOLBAR_ITEMS in Notepad++'s order with separators: New | Open | Save | Save All | Close | Close All | Print || Cut | Copy | Paste | Undo | Redo || Find | Replace | Find in Files || Zoom In | Zoom Out | Reset Zoom || Sync Vertical Scroll | Sync Horizontal Scroll || Word Wrap | Show All Characters | Indent Guide | Document Map | Function List || Start Recording | Stop Recording | Play Macro. Each item is { commandId, tooltip, iconId, separatorBefore? }.

4. Wire each button through CommandRegistry: onClick executes the command, disabled reflects `commands.isEnabled(id)`, and a 'pressed' class reflects `commands.isToggled(id)`. Re-render on CommandRegistry.onDidChange and on EditorManager.onCurrentEditorChanged so enablement tracks state the way Notepad++ greys out Save on a clean document.

5. Accessibility: the toolbar element gets role="toolbar" and aria-label="Notepadia toolbar"; buttons get aria-label from the tooltip and aria-pressed for toggles; implement roving tabindex so the toolbar is one tab stop and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move between buttons; support Escape to return focus to the editor.

6. Create NotepadiaToolbarContribution as a FrontendApplicationContribution that on onDidInitializeLayout calls `shell.addWidget(widget, { area: 'top' })` and orders it below the menubar. Inspect ApplicationShell's top area API in node_modules/@theia/core/lib/browser/shell/application-shell.d.ts first; if the top area rejects a second widget in 1.75, attach the widget's node directly under #theia-top-panel and manage disposal manually.

7. Register command notepadia.view.toggleToolbar, default on, persisted in a preference 'notepadia.toolbar.visible' (add a PreferenceContribution with a schema so it appears in Settings), and add View > Toolbar with isToggled bound to it.

8. Style in notepadia-toolbar.css: 26px row height, 4px padding, 1px bottom border using the theme's tab.border token, 24x24 buttons with 2px radius, hover background from the theme, 6px-wide separators drawn as a 1px vertical rule. No hard-coded colors - use var(--theia-*) tokens.
9. Build, run, and compare against a Notepad++ screenshot. Check the toolbar survives window resize down to 800px wide (wrap or horizontally scroll rather than clipping).
acceptanceCriteria: A toolbar renders between the menubar and the tab bar on first load with no user action.
Every button executes the same command as its menu entry; disabled/toggled states track the active editor.
Keyboard: the toolbar is reachable by Tab, arrow keys move within it, Enter/Space activates, Escape returns to the editor.
View > Toolbar hides and shows it and the choice survives reload.
tests: New e2e suite e2e/toolbar.cjs: assert the toolbar exists on load; click the New button and assert a new tab appears; type into it and assert the Save button becomes enabled; click Word Wrap and assert the editor's wrapping option changed; toggle View > Toolbar and assert it disappears and reappears after reload.
Add 'toolbar' to SUITES in e2e/run.cjs.

tasks.title: Tab bar fidelity
tasks.nppReference: Notepad++ document tab bar and its right-click menu; Settings > Preferences > General > Tab Bar

Decorate EditorWidget titles with an icon class: notepadia-tab-dirty (red floppy) when Saveable.isDirty(widget), notepadia-tab-saved (blue floppy) otherwise, notepadia-tab-readonly (padlock) when the editor is read-only.
2. Draw the three 16x16 icons as SVG in the icon sprite from A3 and expose them as CSS background-image classes in notepadia-shell.css so the decorator only sets class names.

3. Confirm the decorator refires on save/dirty transitions - subscribe to Saveable.onDirtyChanged (or the widget's onDidChangeDirty) and call fireDidChangeDecorations(); a decorator that only runs at open time is a bug.

4. Build the Notepad++ tab context menu in notepadia-tab-context-menu.ts against CommonMenus.SHELL_TABBAR_CONTEXT_MENU: Close, Close All BUT This, Close All to the Left, Close All to the Right, Save, Save As..., Rename, Delete from Disk, Reload from Disk, Print, Read-Only toggle, Clear Read-Only Flag, Copy File Path / Copy File Name / Copy Directory Path, Move to Other View, Clone to Other View. Right-clicking a tab shows the Notepad++ entry set and no VS Code-only entries.
Middle-click closes a tab, prompting to save when dirty.

tasks.title: Status bar parity and a real INS/OVR mode
tasks.nppReference: Notepad++ status bar: 'length : N  lines : N' | 'Ln : N  Col : N  Pos : N' | 'Sel : N | N' | EOL | encoding | INS/OVR
tasks.problem: notepadia-status-bar-contribution.ts shows language, Ln/Col, encoding, EOL and indent, and hard-codes the text 'INS'. Document length, line count, caret offset, selection size and a working overtype mode are all missing.
steps: 1. Create src/common/status-fields.ts with pure formatters: formatLength(chars, lines) -> 'length : 1,234  lines : 56'; formatCaret(line, col, offset) -> 'Ln : 3  Col : 12  Pos : 47'; formatSelection(chars, lines) -> 'Sel : 18 | 2' and 'Sel : 0 | 0' when empty. Match Notepad++'s thousands separators and spacing exactly.

2. Unit test every formatter in extensions/notepadia/test/status-fields.test.cjs including zero, single-line, multi-selection and large-number cases. This is the cheapest correctness win in the whole document.

3. In notepadia-status-bar-contribution.ts add the three new elements at the correct priorities so left-to-right ordering matches Notepad++ (length/lines leftmost of the group, then caret, then selection, then EOL, encoding, INS/OVR).

4. Source the values from the model, not from cached state: model.getValueLength(), model.getLineCount(), model.getOffsetAt(position), and for selection sum getValueLengthInRange over control.getSelections() plus the spanned line count. Subscribe to control.onDidChangeCursorPosition and onDidChangeCursorSelection in addition to the existing onDidChangeContent.

5. Throttle the update: coalesce into a single requestAnimationFrame per burst. Recomputing document length on every keystroke of a 50 MB file will stall the UI; measure with a large file before and after.

6. Implement overtype in notepadia-overtype-contribution.ts. First check whether the bundled Monaco exposes 'editor.action.toggleOvertypeInsertMode' (grep node_modules/@theia/monaco-editor-core/esm/vs/editor for the action id). If present, bind Insert to it and read the mode back from the editor's option. If absent, implement it: a per-editor flag, a keydown/type interception that when overtype is on replaces the character to the right of the caret rather than inserting, disabled for selections, multi-cursor and IME composition.

7. Register command notepadia.toggleOvertype, bind it to the Insert key in notepadia-keybinding-contribution.ts, and make the status bar element read INS or OVR from the flag and act as a click-to-toggle.
8. Add the caret-shape change Notepad++ users expect: overtype renders a block caret (`control.updateOptions({ cursorStyle: 'block' })`), insert renders a line caret.
acceptanceCriteria: All six Notepad++ status fields are present, correctly formatted and live-updating.
Insert toggles INS/OVR, the caret changes shape, and typing overwrites in OVR mode.
Typing in a 10 MB file has no perceptible status bar lag.
tests: Unit: status-fields.test.cjs formatter coverage.

New e2e suite e2e/status-bar.cjs: open bookmarks.txt, assert length/lines text; click line 3 and assert Ln/Col/Pos; select two lines and assert Sel; press Insert, assert OVR appears, type a character and assert the model replaced rather than inserted.
Add 'status-bar' to SUITES in e2e/run.cjs.

workstreams.title: The Find/Replace/Mark dialog

tasks.title: Extended search mode transform (closes the M23 deferral)
tasks.nppReference: Notepad++ Find dialog > Search Mode > Extended (\n, \r, \t, \0, \x..., \o..., \d..., \b...)

tasks.title: Local file open and save from the user's own computer
tasks.nppReference: Notepad++ File > Open / Save - which in Notepad++ always means the user's own disk
tasks.problem: notepadia-menu-contribution.ts unregisters 'file.upload' and 'file.download'. In the browser, File > Open... browses the SERVER's workspace, not the user's machine. As shipped, a remote user of this app has no way to open a file from their laptop or get one back. For an editor described as a Notepad++ replacement this is the most serious functional defect in the repository.
steps: 1. Decide and document the model: the server workspace is 'the workspace'; the user's disk is reached through explicit Open From / Save To commands. Notepad++ users will not infer this, so the menu labels must say it.

2. Implement Open From This Computer... using the File System Access API (window.showOpenFilePicker) when available. Read the file, create an untitled resource with the content through UntitledResourceResolver, open it in the editor, and keep the FileSystemFileHandle so a later Save writes back to the same file on disk.
3. Implement the fallback for browsers without the API (Firefox, Safari): a hidden <input type="file" multiple> click, FileReader, same untitled-resource path, with Save falling back to a download.
4. Implement Save To This Computer... via showSaveFilePicker when available and a Blob + <a download> fallback otherwise. Name the file from the tab title.

5. When a document was opened through a FileSystemFileHandle, make the normal Ctrl+S write back through that handle rather than to the server workspace, and reflect the real filename in the tab and status bar. This is what makes the app feel like Notepad++ rather than like a hosted IDE.
6. Restore 'file.upload' and 'file.download' to the File menu under Notepad++-legible labels ('Upload to Workspace...', 'Download a Copy') so the server-workspace route is also reachable.
7. Handle the permission and abort cases explicitly: a cancelled picker is not an error; a denied write permission needs a clear message naming the file.
8. Document the whole model in docs/usage.md with a short table of which command touches which storage, and note the browser support matrix for the File System Access API.
acceptanceCriteria: A user on a remote machine can open a local file, edit it, and save it back to the same local file in a Chromium browser.
The same flow degrades to upload/download in Firefox without errors.
The File menu makes clear which commands touch the server workspace and which touch the user's disk.
tests: e2e cannot drive the native picker; test the fallback path instead. 3. Keep the Notepad++-native binding registered as well, so the installed-PWA and Electron contexts (where some of these are deliverable) behave correctly.

4. Guard the zoom bindings: Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0 collide with browser zoom. Add a keydown listener in the shell contribution that calls preventDefault for these when the editor has focus, so editor zoom wins inside the app. Verify this does not break the user's ability to zoom the page itself when focus is outside the editor.
